versions.changelog:
Initial release of the E-Commerce Email Marketing Builder skill.

- Generate complete, copy-paste-ready e-commerce email automation flows for key journeys: welcome, cart/browse abandonment, post-purchase, review request, cross-sell, win-back, VIP/loyalty, replenishment, and sunset.
- Delivers full copywriting, subject lines, multiple A/B test variants, preview text, ESP setup instructions, and branching logic for each flow.
- Includes customizable ESP setup (Klaviyo, Omnisend, Mailchimp, Shopify Email, or recommendations).
- Builds annual email campaign calendar with product-specific seasonal events and segmentation strategy.
- Suggests list growth and capture tactics tailored to business stage and platform.
- Activation and onboarding streamlined via multi-choice questionnaire; results instantly tailored to your business.
